decisions.statement: The script is read into another shell's run rather than run on its own.
A shell reading this script reads the secrets held outside the repo.
A shell that was handed no credentials file is pointed at the file its account signed in with.
A name the shell already has is left alone.
A pipeline fails on the first command in that pipeline that fails.
A shell reading the script is not left with a failing status.
A shell reaches this script by a link outside every checkout.
The credentials file's name is worked out here rather than read off the account's page.

definition: what every non-interactive bash the harness starts is given before it runs
